initial_errors: B007: Loop control variable `worker_id` not used within loop body

fix_summary: Added file-based locking using fcntl.flock to prevent race condition in ID generation. The fix introduces a new `add_todo` method in TodoStorage that performs load→compute_id→save as an atomic operation with exclusive file locking.
